delfos.title: Full Stack Developer
delfos.subtitle: Delfos Energy - Barcelona, Spain (08/2021 - Present)
delfos.details: Developed Inspector 3.0, replacing a legacy system with a modern, intuitive, and maintainable application. Focused on offline inspection workflows, the app supports custom forms, image, audio, and signature attachments; developed Delfos Monitor, an application for monitoring solar energy assets; implemented a deployment optimization that reduced release times and improved the development workflow; serve as the team's primary code reviewer, helping maintain code quality and support the team's technical growth; leverage Claude Code to streamline my workflow—from task planning and AI-assisted code generation (carefully reviewed and validated) to documentation that helps QA engineers ensure software quality.

proaero.title: Freelance Full Stack Developer
proaero.subtitle: ProAero - São Paulo, Brazil (10/2023 - 02/2025)
proaero.details: Contributed to the development of Axis, an offline application for pilots focused on flight management, while also working on the web platform, API, and database; led the development of Vowe Air, a flight booking application based on monthly flight-hour packages, from the initial architecture to feature implementation, while also contributing to the web platform, API, and database; migrated the Quartz Hexapod Selaz application to a modern architecture with updated components and dependencies.

terapia_de_bolso.title: Freelance Front-end Developer
terapia_de_bolso.subtitle: Terapia de Bolso - Rondônia, Brazil (02/2023 - 09/2023)
terapia_de_bolso.details: Replaced the PDF generation library with a lighter and more efficient solution capable of converting HTML into searchable PDFs with real text instead of static images, significantly reducing file sizes and improving readability; developed new features for the platform, contributing to its continuous evolution; fixed bugs that directly impacted the user experience, including inconsistent pagination and mobile responsiveness issues.

cernovapps.title: Mobile Development Intern
cernovapps.subtitle: CernovApps - São Paulo, Brazil (03/2021 - 07/2021)
cernovapps.details: Contributed to the development of the Quartz Hexapod Selaz application, featuring an intuitive interface for monitoring patient treatment; developed new features and fixed bugs in a React dashboard; assisted in developing new API features, fixing bugs, and completely restructuring the API documentation.
